pick.name: Sunstretch the Red Tabby Cat
pick.description: Sunstretch, a red-orange tabby with bold black stripes and copper eyes, starts each day with one long stretch on the warm garden path. A cat coin priced in LULU. Not affiliated with lululemon athletica, Backpack Securities or StonkFun. No intrinsic value; not financial advice.
pick.look: An ordinary four-legged house cat: a red-orange mackerel tabby with bold near-black stripes and bright copper eyes. It wears nothing. The coat follows the company's 2022 red tiger-print activewear collection. That is a big-cat link only, so the coin is a normal house cat with that striped coat.
